application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

units_released.note: Rule: distinct vehicles among vehicle files. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.source: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.etran.2026.100589, p. 3, Sec. 2.1 and p. 12, Table 1: CUPRA Born and VW ID.3 108s2p NMC pouch (216 cells each), Tesla Model 3 SR+ 106s1p LFP (106 cells); vehicles counted: Cupra 204, Cupra 213, Cupra 288, Cupra 349, Cupra 397, Tesla Model 3 SR+, VW ID.3

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: Cell-voltage columns per vehicle: Cupra 204 108, Cupra 213 108, Cupra 288 108, Cupra 349 108, Cupra 397 108, Tesla Model 3 SR+ 106, VW ID.3 108.

span_unit_years.note: First to last measurement date per vehicle (Cupra 204 2022-11-16 to 2022-11-18, Cupra 213 2022-11-29 to 2022-12-11, Cupra 288 2022-11-23 to 2022-12-15, Cupra 349 2022-11-25 to 2022-11-27, Cupra 397 2022-11-11 to 2022-11-13, VW ID.3 2024-04-22 to 2024-06-17); Tesla files carry no timestamps and are left out. This is the calendar span between discrete charge tests, not continuous telemetry.

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://mediatum.ub.tum.de/1840112; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention

overlap_cell_channels_measured.note: Vehicles also in bilfinger2024, shown by identical cell-voltage recordings: Tesla Model 3 SR+, VW ID.3. The bilfinger2026 row counts all seven vehicles; totals subtract the shared vehicles once.
